text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain decides to establish a committee to extend humanitarian help to Palestinians.
- Pharmaceutical products worth 10 million dinars a year are consumed in Bahrain, a Health Ministry official says.
- Trade volume between Bahrain and Ireland dropped to $11.2 million in 1996 compared to $13.3 million in 1995.
- Romania's Tarom Airlines discusses with Bahrain Civil Aviation Authority ways to boost cooperation.
